hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty'); case "$f" in "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/backend/*.go) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; [ -f "$f" ] || exit 0; cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/backend" || exit 0; pkg="./$(dirname "${f#"$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/backend/}")/"; out=$(golangci-lint run "$pkg" 2>&1) || { printf 'golangci-lint found issues in %s:\n%s\n' "$pkg" "$out" >&2; exit 2; }
hooks.statusMessage: golangci-lint on the edited Go package
